text:
Harold: Quick sync - channel asked if we can offer a 'commit + appliance' flow that keeps marketplace discoverability but lets SI attach a managed services retainer. Need guardrails.

Jin: high level: marketplace for visibility, private for any appliance that needs customer-managed keys or on-prem install windows.

Priya: sellers want simple billing. Could we publish a marketplace "anchor SKU" that represents the bundle but spawns a private contract for the appliance install and retainer? Buyer sees one price, we handle split offline.

Mark: yes, but two gotchas: 1) escrow and 2) partner margin in checkout. Marketplace can't escrow. If customer wants escrow -> private-only.

Asha: partner margin can be handled via Partner Portal credits post-checkout. We'll add a line item in the post-purchase email that shows partner_split and expected payout window.

Harold: routing rules proposal: (a) escrow required -> private PO. (b) appliance + KMS -> private. (c) bundle <$275k -> anchor SKU in marketplace that auto-creates a private contract draft for install/retainer. (d) if marketplace quota blocks listing -> fallback private PO with 48h notify.

Jin: add telemetry: emit "anchor_to_private" when usage or install tickets indicate onboarding >14 days or token run-rate exceeds 80% of committed band for 30d. That primes sales/ops.

Priya: renewal flow: if started on anchor SKU, renewal modal should offer conversion to standard commit with a renewal discount ladder (5%/10%/15% at 12/24/36 mo increases). Partner Success handles the upsell play.

Mark: legal needs a clause: purchasing anchor SKU authorizes us to open a private contract for onboarding/off-market escrow and to migrate billing terms if compliance requires. Loop Legal on draft.

Asha: ops: reconciliation runbook needed for monthly retainer draws vs marketplace annual invoice. We'll issue monthly internal credits and reconcile at renewal. Also define overage policy: overage billed at list rate unless band upgraded.

MarketplaceBot: NOTE: security check required for appliance-bundled listings. See ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/PRT-6442

Harold: action items: Jin -> telemetry spec + sample event (due Tue). Priya -> renewal modal copy + Partner Success play (due Wed). Mark -> legal clause draft (due Fri). Asha -> ops reconciliation stub + overage policy (due Thu). I'll draft routing-policy PR and tag Security + Legal.

Jin: ack, starting on telemetry events.

Priya: will draft the modal and share sample copy.

Mark: looping Legal now.

Asha: working on runbook, will include failure and rollback steps.

MarketplaceBot: PR created: https://redwood.internal/prs/8607 - partnerships/anchor-sku-bundle (Harold).
